text.offer: Princess Kateriina says, "The Duke's raiders burn the farms on the Barloque road. Drive them off - six of them - and then go to Priestess Xiana at the Temple of Shal'ille. My people need her healers, and she should know the crown stands with her."
text.progress: The Duke's soldiers guard the flagpoles he holds. The Temple of Shal'ille is in Marion.
text.complete: Priestess Xiana bows her head. "Tell the Princess her healers will come. Shal'ille takes no side in a war, but she remembers who keeps the peace." (Your liege has more for you at 25 renown. Fight in the lieges' battles, claim flags, and take their daily war errands to earn it.)
